name: fullstack4j
description: The fullstack4j skill, the Wicket Oat skill it builds pages with, and the wicket-testkit skill for page tests.

plugins.name: fullstack4j
plugins.description: Build and change features in a fullstack4j application: declare a slice's spec, then make the code match it until ./mvnw verify is green.

plugins.name: wicket-oat
plugins.description: Wicket Oat, the themeable component library for Apache Wicket: buttons, forms, cards, dialogs, tabs, toasts and themes.

plugins.name: wicket-testkit
plugins.description: wicket-testkit, test helpers for Apache Wicket: locate components by type, wicket:id, label, model object and row instead of WicketTester paths, fill in forms, and compare rows with example tables.
